scope: Read-only product/source review of October 7 Report recovery/details and October 8 Staff/Template simplification, plus current-run phone screenshots. This is not the full release gate.

checks: Failed queued Report Retry/Recover actions appear before details and delegate the unchanged original record identity/captured answers/evidence to existing recovery and replay handlers; session, Worker, Department and connected-node guards remain.
The promoted action pair shares an in-flight guard. Expansion retains a single action set. Discard stays secondary in expanded details and delegates the existing confirmation and queue-lock path.

Report-only details keep answers, signatures, gallery access and final notes. A native details/summary disclosure carries capture/submission/reviewer/review timestamps; saved copies are labelled as device saves and cannot acquire a stale resolved note.

New Report-only Worker invitations explicitly keep normal as the retained class default. Existing-user edits omit worker_class; backend update_user reads model_fields_set and preserves the current class on omission, including a class changed after the editor opened.
Role, Department, self-account, pending-invitation and global-admin controls keep their existing policy. The full-interface override still exposes retained class management.

Template simple view hides field keys, unused conditions and new formula/repeat choices. Existing formulas, groups and conditions remain editable; load, draft restore and raw apply expose configured advanced behavior.

The advanced-options switch changes view state without Definition mutation or draft scheduling; the actual edit-form input listener explicitly excludes this checkbox, while ordinary field/name/description edits continue saving.
No asset or index.html source changes exist between the October 8 feature commit and the reviewed HEAD.

visualReview.freshness: Every reviewed image modification time is after the current mobile-run start; focused-suite completion was confirmed by the gate owner before inspection.
visualReview.reportDetails: Six 320px English/light and 390px Chinese/dark fixtures show readable full failure warnings, primary recovery actions before disclosure, full final-note access, signatures, six-photo previews with complete-gallery controls, More details and Supervisor PDF controls without clipping.
visualReview.templates: Four simple/configured-advanced 320px English/light and 390px Chinese/dark builder images show translated view controls, visible labels/inputs, preserved formulas and conditions, and no horizontal overflow.
visualReview.staff: Four actual-app viewport images at 320/390px English/light and Chinese/dark show Worker role, Department and private-invitation guidance without Worker-class controls. At 320px English the lower action area is below the screenshot fold; other captures show Create invitation and Cancel clearly.

validationOwnership: Operations agent owns the complete check:mobile run and its results. This review ran no competing tests or builds and made no application-source or hosted changes.
limitations: Report detail and Template screenshots use the real module/CSS with isolated synthetic callbacks or transport; Staff screenshots use the actual app with intercepted transport.
No authenticated hosted application fixtures were created by this review, and physical iPhone/Android interaction remains unverified.
Historical Staff/invitation timeout causes remain unconfirmed; this source and visual review does not establish their causes or substitute for the full mobile gate.
